data.gender_notes: Naphtali is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Naphtali means 'my struggle' or 'my wrestling'. This name is derived from the Hebrew word 'pethilah' which means 'wrestling' or 'striving'. Naphtali is the name of the sixth son of Jacob and the father of the tribe of Naphtali in the Hebrew Bible. The name Naphtali carries the meaning “My struggle, my wrestling” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Naphtali usually hope their child will grow to embody my struggle, my wrestling and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Naphtali belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “My struggle, my wrestling.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naphtali total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Naphtali has been used as a given name for both males and females in the Christian world. It has been a popular choice among various Christian denominations throughout history, especially in the Middle Ages. The name is also used in the Anglican and Catholic churches. The name Naphtali holds a cultural significance as a reminder of the struggles and wrestlings that come with life, and the importance of persevering through these challenges.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Bible, Naphtali is not only the name of a son of Jacob and a tribe, but it is also featured in the story of Jacob's wrestling match with God. This spiritual significance highlights the importance of having faith and persevering through life's struggles, as Naphtali did when he wrestled with God and did not let go until he received a blessing. The name Naphtali serves as a reminder of the importance of remaining steadfast in our faith, even in the face of difficulties and challenges.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Naphtali means "wrestling with God" in Hebrew, symbolizing the spiritual struggle and deep connection between the individual and the divine.
